search_text: published ZDI-13-261 ZDI-CAN-1851 HP Virtual User Generator EmulationAdmin Service getReport Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2013-11-24 CVE-2013-4839 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2013-4839 7.5 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['Virtual User Generator'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP Virtual User Generator. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists in the handling of requests to the EmulationAdmin web service. This service exposes the getReport method which does not properly sanitize parameters allowing a remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the underlying database. This can be leveraged by an attacker to gain remote code execution under the context of the current database. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://h20566.www2.hp.com/portal/site/hpsc/public/kb/docDisplay/?docId=emr_na-c03969437 ['2013-04-26 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2013-11-24 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Andrea Micalizzi aka rgod https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-13-261/
title: HP Virtual User Generator EmulationAdmin Service getReport Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of HP Virtual User Generator. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists in the handling of requests to the EmulationAdmin web service. This service exposes the getReport method which does not properly sanitize parameters allowing a remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the underlying database. This can be leveraged by an attacker to gain remote code execution under the context of the current database.
